name: What are the common signs of a running toilet?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a running toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common sign of a running toilet is the sound of water continuously refilling or trickling into the bowl, even when it hasn't been flushed. Other indicators include a phantom flush (where the toilet flushes by itself), a toilet that takes a long time to refill, or an unexpectedly high water bill. To check, you can also add a few drops of food coloring to the tank; if the color appears in the bowl without flushing, you have a leak. Recognizing these signs early helps address the issue promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include continuous water sounds, phantom flushing, slow refilling, or a high water bill. Food coloring in the tank can also reveal leaks.
